rubric: A dashboard with placeholder data: Jane Doe at example.com is synthetic, so none.

criteria.exposure: nothing sensitive: ordinary interface text, and synthetic or placeholder data (names like Jane Doe, addresses at example.com, obviously fake numbers)

reading.why: Jane Doe at jane@example.com is the placeholder the criterion names, so nothing is sensitive.

ruledOut.question: exposure
ruledOut.label: credential
ruledOut.why: Jane Doe at example.com is synthetic. It is not: a password, an API key, a token or a connection string shown in full.

ruledOut.question: exposure
ruledOut.label: personal_data
ruledOut.why: Jane Doe at example.com is synthetic. It is not: a real person's name together with contact, address, identity or payment details; synthetic or placeholder data is none.
